chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

My daughter Fatima will be resurrected while she is wearing the vestment of honor, which has been kneaded with the water of life; the creatures will look at her and be amazed by her. Then she will also be clothed in a thousand vestments from the vestments of Paradise, written on each vestment in green script: 'Enter the daughter of Muhammad into Paradise in the best appearance, the best honor, and the best sight.' She will be escorted to Paradise like a bride is escorted, and seventy thousand maidservants will be assigned to her.
ai.seo_question: What are the unique honors and garments bestowed upon Fatima (a.s.) at resurrection?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights the unique eschatological status of Fatima al-Zahra (peace be upon her) as the 'Pillar of Paradise,' emphasizing her preeminent rank among all creation. The imagery of garments 'kneaded with the water of life' and the thousand heavenly vestments underscores her spiritual purity and the divine honor bestowed upon her, reflecting the Shia belief in her intercessory role and eternal glory. This description serves to affirm her identity not merely as the Prophet's daughter, but as a central figure in the cosmic order of the Hereafter.
